chars.WIFE: WIFE: a young Moroccan woman wearing a mustard-yellow hijab and a long olive-green cardigan over a cream dress.
chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a calm Moroccan man in a light-blue civil-servant shirt with a dark-blue tie and beige trousers.
chars.SALAH: SALAH: a cocky young Moroccan man wearing a red tracksuit jacket with white stripes, black jeans and a silver chain.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In the doorway of a modest Moroccan apartment living room, the HUSBAND happily introduces his new friend SALAH with an arm on his shoulder; SALAH smirks at the WIFE; the WIFE stands frozen in shock holding a tea tray, eyes wide. Moroccan salon with banquettes behind.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan salon: the HUSBAND laughs looking away, while behind his back SALAH gives the WIFE a sly wink; the WIFE glares back at SALAH, tense and furious.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Outside a small Moroccan driving school with a learner car parked: the WIFE walks out holding her bag and stops, surprised, as SALAH leans casually against a car waiting for her, grinning.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: A narrow Moroccan city street with old walls: SALAH steps in front of the WIFE blocking her path with one arm out, talking pushily; the WIFE leans back annoyed.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan street: the WIFE points her finger firmly at SALAH, angry, scolding him; SALAH raises his hands with a fake innocent smile.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Night, front door of the Moroccan apartment: the HUSBAND comes home late, tie loose and tired-looking, with SALAH laughing next to him; the WIFE in the hallway stares at them, worried, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan kitchen at evening: the WIFE stands by the counter holding her phone, shocked, hand over her mouth, reading messages; a teapot on the stove.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: The WIFE sits on a Moroccan banquette typing furiously on her phone with an angry face, the phone held in both hands.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SALAH lies on a sofa in a dim room at night, looking at his phone with a sneaky provocative smirk, lit by the phone glow.
